title: Raise PAYMENTS_DB_POOL from 20 to 40
description: Doubles the per-pod connection pool in deploy/helm/values.yaml ahead of the December peak. 3 pods x 40 = 120 connections, still under max_connections (200).

expected.summary: 2 pages flag. Fail over the payments database (High: its code block quotes the removed line PAYMENTS_DB_POOL: "20"). Payments deployment and Helm chart (Medium: deploy/helm/** glob plus the same snippet).

pages.title: Fail over the payments database
pages.why: Exact anchor deploy/helm/values.yaml (normal, +1/-1) scores 0.43; the snippet hash of PAYMENTS_DB_POOL: "20" adds 0.4, so 0.83.

pages.title: Payments deployment and Helm chart
pages.why: Glob anchor deploy/helm/** (normal) scores 0.26; the snippet hash adds 0.4, so 0.66.

expected.mustNotFlagWhy: They anchor deploy/helm/values.yaml too, but do not quote the changed line. PAYMENTS_DB_POOL is still present on the + side, so it is not a removed identifier.
